sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.

This is a petition seeking the following reliefs:
"A. Issue of a writ, order or direction in the nature of a mandamus or any other appropriate writ quashing and setting- aside the Office Memorandum dated 27.10.2010 bearing No. 25016/31/2010- lmm; and the Office memorandum dated 05.12.2017 bearing no. 25016/10/2017-lmm[Pt.]; and the Office Memorandum dated 19.07.2018 bearing no.
25016/10/2017-lmm [Pt]; and the Office Memorandum dated 12.10.2018 bearing No.
25016/10/2017- lmm [Pt] issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs/Respondent No 1;
AND/OR; B. Issue of a writ, order or direction in the nature of a certiorari calling upon the Respondent No. 3 to produce the file relating to Look Out Circular issued in connection with FIR No. 113/2021 dated 26.07.2021 and if the same is found to be in violation of law quash and/or setting-aside the same; C. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of a mandamus or any other appropriate writ setting aside the Vaibhav Maloo vs Union Of India And Ors. & Anr on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131986021/
1 Look-Out Circular[s] issued against the Petitioner in connection with FIR No.
113/2021 dated 26.07.2021 in P.S. Economic Offences Wing, New Delhi;
D. Pass any such order(s) as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the interest of justice."

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Mr. Luthra, learned senior counsel does not press prayer (a) and hence the same stands withdrawn.
It is stated by Mr. Luthra, learned senior counsel for the petitioner that there are no allegations against the petitioner.
Despite the same, LoC has been issued against the petitioner in connection with FIR No. 113/2021, PS EOW u/s 406/420/120B IPC.
Issue notice.
Mr. Ahluwalia, learned CGSC accepts notice for respondent Nos. 1 and 2.

Ms.
Bandhopadhya, learned ASC accepts notice for respondent No. 3.
Issue notice to respondent No. 4 on the petitioner taking steps within 1 week from today, returnable on 28.03.2023.
It is stated by Mr. Ahluwalia that LoC in the present case has been opened on the basis of the request made by EoW, Delhi.
This is an application seeking stay of LoC issued to respondent Nos. 1 to 3.
If the application is allowed, it would be allowing the petition which cannot be done at an interim stage.
However, the petitioner may file an application as and when he has to travel abroad seeking suspension of LoC and the same shall be adjudicated on its own merit.
Subject to the above, the application is dismissed.
Mr. Luthra has handed over a compilation wherein it is stated that the petitioner needs to travel to Dubai and Moscow in the last week of March till 07.04.2023.
The respondent shall verify the same and file a status report.
JASMEET SINGH, J MARCH 23, 2023/dm
